title: Pines speculates the psionic programs use genetic lines, drug cocktails and youth training

tellings.quote: protocols. They realize that there's certain individuals that have an inherent predisposition for this. They maybe have figured out genetic, you know, lines that are just naturally disposed for this. They figure out maybe some cocktails of drugs to give to people in a training regimen when they're young and then they get them into these programs

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher who writes about national security, guesses on Jesse Michels' podcast how secret government programs might train people in psionics, meaning abilities of the mind such as sensing things at a distance. He imagines they find people who are naturally gifted, maybe from certain family lines, give them mixes of drugs as part of training when they are young, and then bring them into the programs. If true, it would mean governments are deliberately growing mind powers in people.
